title: Danny Beard wins UK Series 4
summary: In the Grand Finale (UK-S04-E10), Danny Beard and Cheddar Gorgeous lip-synced to Shirley Bassey's "This Is My Life". Danny Beard was crowned the winner; Cheddar Gorgeous finished as runner-up. Black Peppa and Jonbers Blonde placed third and fourth. Early UK series offered no cash prize.

title: Just May: Series 4 Porkchop
summary: Just May was the first contestant eliminated on RuPaul's Drag Race UK Series 4 (UK-S04-E01), lip-syncing to Mabel's "Let Them Know" against Dakota Schiffer.

title: Baby quits after the Rusical lip sync
summary: In UK-S04-E05, Baby and Dakota Schiffer lip-synced to "No Way" from Six. After the lip sync, Baby left the competition; Dakota Schiffer remained safe.

title: Double shantay on The Squirrel Games
summary: In UK-S04-E08, Black Peppa and Jonbers Blonde lip-synced to Booty Luv's "Some Kinda Rush". Both won the lip sync and no one was eliminated.

title: RuPaul misses Queen Team Makeovers
summary: RuPaul missed filming UK-S04-E07, the first episode he has missed across Drag Race franchises he hosts. Michelle Visage hosted; Raven guest-judged alongside Boy George, becoming the first former Drag Race contestant to judge on a RuPaul-fronted franchise.
